name: brief2motion
description: Turn a plain brief into a website with professional motion, checked in a real browser: scroll stories, 3D product pages, kinetic type, page transitions, data stories, interface motion, particles, and 32 visual styles. Sibling of brief2mp4.

interface.shortDescription: Write a brief, get a website that moves
interface.longDescription: Paste a plain brief and the agent builds a website with motion: it picks the stack (plain CSS and JavaScript, GSAP, Motion, three.js, View Transitions, SVG, Lottie) and a visual style from the brief, builds the page, then measures it in a real browser on desktop and an emulated phone, with reduced motion, without WebGL and without JavaScript, and fixes what fails.
defaultPrompt: Use the brief2motion skill to build the page in this brief:
Check the motion in a real browser.
